post.description:
Confirms the pending secret from the setup with a first code from the authenticator app.
Only then is two-factor authentication enabled with this secret and required for the user; a previous secret is
replaced.
A wrong code answers 422 and the setup stays pending; without a pending setup the answer is 409.

200.description: Two-factor authentication is enabled with the new secret.

Refused with 403 while two-factor authentication is required for the user, so it only removes a setup that is no

delete.description:
Resets the two-factor authentication of a user: disables it and removes the secret.
Whether it is required for the user stays as it is; a required user sets it up again at the next login.
Admins may reset any user, other users with user management only themselves.

200.description: Two-factor authentication of the user is reset.

post.description:
Creates a new secret for the current user's authenticator app, for a first setup or a renewal.
The secret is not active yet: it waits in the session until a first code confirms it, so during a
renewal the current secret keeps working. Show `otpauthUri` as a QR code and `secret` for manual entry.
It is also the only endpoint open during a login in the `setup` step; the first code then goes to `/login/2fa`.

200.description: The new secret, its otpauth URI and the number of digits in a code.
